tasks.label: tachyon: build-dev-host
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; PTR="${workspaceFolder}/.tachyon/dev-host"; test -e "$PTR/extension" || { echo "Tachyon Dev Host is not armed. Run: npm run dogfood:dev-host -- point --worktree <path> --workspace <fixture>" >&2; exit 1; }; EXT="$(cd "$PTR/extension" && pwd -P)"; test -d "$EXT/node_modules" || ln -sfn "${workspaceFolder}/node_modules" "$EXT/node_modules"; npm run build --prefix "$EXT"
